_meta.description: Scratch strict fixtures for the REPAIR-041 two-turn delegation-log check (bia-subagents-two-turn.mjs), served by a scratch AIMock on :4411 only. Turn 1 delegates once to research_agent, turn 2 (same thread, turn 1 in its history) delegates once to writing_agent. Each run's follow-up is gated on hasToolResult (the current turn carries the sub-agent's tool result) and its own prompt, so each leg can only match its own run; not on toolCallId, which @tanstack/openai-base 0.9.2 replaces with the Responses item id. No turnIndex: the second run's history already holds turn 1's assistant messages.
